name: Thunder Rangers - Leiting You Qibing
source:
In the captivating visual novel "Thunder Ranger," players delve into a remarkable story alongside the valiant protagonist, Walker. The narrative unfolds in an America transformed by advanced AI, where Walker and his steadfast partner and lover, Ofnir, emerge as the newest recruits of the prestigious Law Enforcement Agency known as the Thunder Rangers.

As Thunder Rangers, Walker and Ofnir embark on an enthralling journey through a society profoundly influenced by artificial intelligence. Together, they navigate a world where mortals existence is intricately intertwined with the marvels and complexities of AI technology.

Immersed in this visually stunning experience, players will witness Walker's encounters with cyber-criminals exploiting advanced technologies, confrontations with supernatural activities,and the challenges of maintaining law and order in a society forever changed by AI.

As the narrative unfolds, players will uncover a captivating tale that weaves together the past, present, and future, revealing the mysteries that lie beneath the surface of this brave new America. The emotional depth of the story, complemented by captivating artwork and a mesmerizing characters, ensures players are fully immersed in the world of "Thunder Ranger."

Prepare to be captivated by the dilemmas, and poignant moments that define Walker's journey as a Thunder Ranger. In this visual novel, you will experience the bond between Walker and Ofnir, explore the delicate balance between mortals and AI, and ultimately determine the fate of a nation on the precipice of a technological revolution.

[From [url=https://thunderrangers.itch.io/thunderrangers]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在引人入胜的视觉小说《雷霆游侠》中，玩家将与勇敢的主角沃克一起深入了解一个非凡的故事。故事发生在一个被先进人工智能改造的美国，沃克和他坚定的伙伴兼爱人奥夫尼尔成为著名的执法机构雷霆游骑兵的最新成员。

作为雷霆游骑兵，沃克和奥夫尼尔踏上了一段迷人的旅程，穿越了一个深受人工智能影响的社会。他们一起探索一个凡人的存在与人工智能技术的奇迹和复杂性错综复杂地交织在一起的世界。

沉浸在这种令人惊叹的视觉体验中，玩家将目睹沃克与利用先进技术的网络犯罪分子的遭遇，与超自然活动的对抗，以及在人工智能永远改变的社会中维持法律和秩序的挑战。

随着剧情的展开，玩家将揭开一个将过去、现在和未来交织在一起的引人入胜的故事，揭开这个勇敢的新美国表面之下的神秘面纱。故事的情感深度，辅以迷人的艺术作品和迷人的角色，确保玩家完全沉浸在《雷霆游侠》的世界中。

准备好被沃克雷霆游侠之旅中的困境和辛酸时刻所吸引吧。在这部视觉小说中，你将体验沃克和奥夫尼尔之间的联系，探索凡人与人工智能之间的微妙平衡，并最终决定一个处于技术革命边缘的国家的命运。

[来自[url=https://thunderrangers.itch.io/thunderrangers]Itch.io[/url]]
